2608.13465.title: Concept Drift Detection and Adaptive Retraining of Malware Classification Models
2608.13465.paper_summary: Concept drift refers to changes over time in the statistical properties of data, as compared to the data that was used to train a learning model. Machine learning models for malware detection or classification are particularly susceptible to performance degradation caused by concept drift, as attackers constantly modify existing malware. In this chapter, we analyze two machine learning-based approaches to automated concept drift detection-a novel approach based on One-Class Support Vector Machines (OCSVM) and a previously-studied technique based on Minibatch K-Means (MK-Means). For comparison we also consider Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), a statistical technique for detecting changes in multidimensional data. We conduct an extensive series of experiments comparing the effectiveness of four learning models, namely, Multilayer Perceptron, Random Forest, Support Vector Machines, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting. For each of these models, we consider three distinct scenarios: A static scenario where no model retraining occurs, a periodic scenario where models are constantly retrained irrespective of concept drift, and a drift-aware scenario where models are only retrained when concept drift is detected. Under the drift-aware scenario, we analyze the tradeoff between accuracy and training efficiency using Pareto Front analysis. We find that all three concept drift detection techniques achieve classification accuracy comparable to periodic retraining, while offering substantially greater efficiency in terms of the number of models that must be retrained. In addition, drift-aware retraining based on our OCSVM technique generally outperforms the MK-Means and MMD approaches. Overall, these results provide strong evidence that we can accurately detect concept drift in malware classification models.
2608.13465.paper_summary_zh: 概念漂移是指隨著時間推移，數據的統計特性發生變化，與用於訓練學習模型的數據相比。<lb/>針對惡意軟體檢測或分類的機器學習模型特別容易受到概念漂移造成的性能下降影響，因為攻擊者不斷修改現有的惡意軟體。<lb/>在本章中，我們分析了兩種基於機器學習的自動概念漂移檢測方法——一種基於單類支持向量機（OCSVM）的新穎方法，以及一種基於小批量K均值（MK-Means）的先前研究技術。<lb/>為了比較，我們還考慮了最大均值差異（MMD），這是一種用於檢測多維數據變化的統計技術。<lb/>我們進行了一系列廣泛的實驗，比較四種學習模型的有效性，即多層感知器、隨機森林、支持向量機和極限梯度提升。<lb/>對於這些模型中的每一個，我們考慮了三種不同的情境：一種靜態情境，其中不進行模型再訓練；一種定期情境，其中模型不論概念漂移如何都會不斷再訓練；以及一種漂移感知情境，其中只有在檢測到概念漂移時才會再訓練模型。<lb/>在漂移感知情境下，我們使用Pareto前沿分析來分析準確性和訓練效率之間的權衡。<lb/>我們發現這三種概念漂移檢測技術都能實現與定期再訓練相當的分類準確性，同時在必須再訓練的模型數量方面提供了顯著更高的效率。<lb/>此外，基於我們的OCSVM技術的漂移感知再訓練通常優於MK-Means和MMD方法。<lb/>總體而言，這些結果提供了強有力的證據，表明我們可以準確檢測到惡意軟體分類模型中的概念漂移。
